purpose: Bounded W1.3a physical and stability diagnostic; not production promotion
identity: controlled specimen from ANYsolver/tests/test_solid_coupling.py; independent analytic nu=0 strip limits

stability_diagnostic.spd_check: bounded dense Cholesky of verification V, at most 1500 reduced coordinates; never a physical-solve fallback
stability_diagnostic.V_norm: P.T*(K+(E/L^2)*M_density1)*P; norm only, never added to physical stiffness
stability_diagnostic.claim: finite-case diagnostic spectra only; no inf-sup uniform bound or locking qualification inferred

failure_policy: retain failed case and do not loosen references or limits; stop promotion and report scientific uncertainty
